# Copilot instructions for MyOS

Follow the repository-level `AGENTS.md` as the source of project rules. MyOS is an independent freestanding x86_64 operating-system project; do not substitute Linux components or claim unimplemented functionality.

Make focused, incremental changes in the established directory structure. Check dependencies between subsystems before implementing one. Avoid fake stubs and success-only placeholders. Run the relevant build/test commands where possible, and report exact results and limitations. Update documentation and roadmap status only to match tested implementation. Do not add generated artifacts to source control.
